valid.name: no-fees
valid.note: plain order, fill pays seller net = price

valid.name: fees-all-paid
valid.note: royalty 5% + market 2% (50/50 listing/settlement), all paid, venue tag present

valid.name: fees-dropped
valid.note: same order, buyer drops all fee outputs: still a valid fill, fee_split_ok=false

valid.name: p2sh-payto-expiry-share
valid.note: pay_to P2SH, expiry set, listing_share 3000, no settlement tag (settlement_fee_ok = null)

valid.name: embedded-psdt
valid.note: optional psdt field equals the canonical rebuild

valid.name: asig-valid
valid.note: asig over the canonical op (fees, listing_to, expiry covered): any inscriber may publish it; verify with Core verifymessage(asig_address, asig, asig_message)

valid.name: p2sh-single-key
valid.note: dog on P2SH(<seller pk> OP_CHECKSIG): redeem_script + sig (no pubkey); scriptCode = redeem_script; asig by the script key

valid.name: p2sh-multisig-2of3
valid.note: 2-of-3 multisig dog, keys 1+3 sign (given as [3,1], emitted in script key order), pays back to the multisig P2SH; asigs by keys 1+3

valid.name: p2sh-multisig-2of3-embedded-psdt
valid.note: embedded psdt equals the rebuild: in1 carries 00 parent, 02 x2 (ascending key), 03, 04 redeem_script; asigs by keys 2+3 (a multisig list always needs asigs)

invalid.name: tampered-price
invalid.why: sig no longer verifies

invalid.name: tampered-pay_to
invalid.why: sig no longer verifies

invalid.name: high-s
invalid.why: non low-S

invalid.name: hashtype-81
invalid.why: sighash must be 0x83

invalid.name: psdt_hash-present
invalid.why: psdt_hash is venue-only

invalid.name: chain-mainnet
invalid.why: chain mismatch

invalid.name: royalty-over-cap
invalid.why: cap is a rejection

invalid.name: price-number
invalid.why: price must be a decimal string

invalid.name: wrong-parent
invalid.why: parent txid mismatch

invalid.name: hijack-non-owner-key
invalid.why: sig is valid for the attacker key but the dog prevout is P2PKH(seller); dojak builder: dog output is not P2PKH of the signer key

invalid.name: net-below-dust
invalid.why: price 120000 with 20% market fee → net 96000 < 100000

invalid.name: asig-tampered-fee
invalid.why: listing_to swapped after signing; SINGLE sig still valid (net unchanged) but asig fails

invalid.name: asig-wrong-key
invalid.why: asig is a valid signature, but by the attacker key, not the order pubkey

invalid.name: asig-replay-other-dog
invalid.why: valid order for a different dog by the same seller, with asig copied from asig-valid (inscription_id/utxo/sig are covered)

invalid.name: asig-high-s
invalid.why: same signature with s → n−s (and flipped recid): mathematically valid, rejected as non low-S

invalid.name: duplicate-key
invalid.why: pay_to appears twice; last-wins parsers see a valid order (dojak: duplicate JSON key "pay_to" at 294)

invalid.name: p2sh-tampered-redeem_script
invalid.why: redeem_script swapped for another 2-of-3 (one key changed): hash160 no longer matches the dog P2SH

invalid.name: p2sh-hijack-own-script
invalid.why: attacker-chosen 2-of-3 with valid sigs over the template; dog prevout is P2SH(seller script)

invalid.name: p2sh-insufficient-sigs
invalid.why: 2-of-3 with one signature

invalid.name: p2sh-sigs-out-of-order
invalid.why: both signatures valid but listed against script key order (OP_CHECKMULTISIG would fail)

invalid.name: p2sh-sigs-duplicate
invalid.why: the same signature twice

invalid.name: p2sh-sigs-high-s
invalid.why: second multisig signature with s → n−s

invalid.name: p2sh-pubkey-and-redeem
invalid.why: pubkey and redeem_script both present

invalid.name: p2sh-multisig-with-sig
invalid.why: multisig redeem_script with sig instead of sigs

invalid.name: p2sh-single-with-sigs
invalid.why: single-key redeem_script with sigs instead of sig

invalid.name: p2sh-unsupported-template
invalid.why: P2PKH script inside P2SH: non-standard for ÐMP (only <pk> CHECKSIG and m-of-n CHECKMULTISIG)

invalid.name: p2sh-asigs-one-of-two
invalid.why: 2-of-3 order with a single asigs entry: one co-signer cannot authorize

invalid.name: p2sh-asig-on-multisig
invalid.why: single asig on a multisig order

invalid.name: p2sh-asigs-wrong-order
invalid.why: asigs valid but not in script key order

invalid.name: p2sh-asigs-non-member
invalid.why: second asig by a key outside the redeem_script

invalid.name: p2sh-asigs-tampered-fee
invalid.why: listing_to swapped after signing: sigs still valid (net unchanged), asigs fail

ordering.name: newer-ts-same-outpoint
ordering.why: ts +60 on the same outpoint replaces

ordering.name: older-ts-same-outpoint
ordering.why: third party re-inscribes the older (higher-fee or cheaper) order: rejected

ordering.name: equal-ts-same-outpoint
ordering.why: equal ts: the first one seen in chain order stays

ordering.name: identical-reinscription
ordering.why: re-inscribing the active order is a no-op

ordering.name: older-ts-other-outpoint
ordering.why: a different outpoint is not compared (the old outpoint is already gone)
